summary: Saved Devices management screen feature testing complete. All 16 backend API tests passed. Frontend SavedDevicesTab renders correctly with all required elements and integrates properly with backend APIs. All CRUD operations work correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/dhu/devices returns all saved devices
Backend: DELETE /api/dhu/device-preferences/{serial} removes device and returns deleted
Backend: DELETE /api/dhu/device-preferences/{serial} returns not_found for unknown device
Backend: POST /api/dhu/device-preferences with updated fields performs upsert
Backend: POST /api/dhu/device-preferences saves preferences to MongoDB
Backend: POST /api/dhu/device-preferences saves bluetooth connection type
Backend: GET /api/dhu/device-preferences/{serial} returns saved preferences
Backend: GET /api/dhu/device-preferences/{serial} returns not_found for unknown device
Backend: POST /api/dhu/device-event with action=connected and new serial returns prompt_needed
Backend: POST /api/dhu/device-event with known device (skip_prompt=true) returns auto_launched
Backend: POST /api/dhu/device-event with known device fullscreen mode returns auto_launched with mode=fullscreen
Backend: POST /api/dhu/device-event with action=disconnected returns stopped
Backend: POST /api/dhu/device-event with unknown action returns ignored
Backend: GET /api/dhu/status returns pending device_event (consumed on read)
Backend: GET /api/dhu/status returns status field (running/stopped)
Backend: GET /api/dhu/devices lists all known devices with all preference fields
Frontend: SavedDevicesTab renders under Settings > Saved Devices navigation item
Frontend: SavedDevicesTab fetches device list from GET /api/dhu/devices on mount
Frontend: SavedDevicesTab shows device cards with name, serial, connection type, display mode
Frontend: SavedDevicesTab shows 'No saved devices yet' when list is empty
Frontend: SavedDevicesTab Refresh button re-fetches device list
Frontend: Device card Remove button deletes device via DELETE /api/dhu/device-preferences/{serial}
Frontend: Device card Connection type toggle (USB/BT) updates via POST /api/dhu/device-preferences
Frontend: Device card Display mode toggle (Embedded/Fullscreen) updates via POST /api/dhu/device-preferences
Frontend: Device card Auto-launch checkbox toggles skip_prompt field
Frontend: Settings navigation shows 'Saved Devices' tab with Smartphone icon
Frontend: Dashboard still renders gauges, warning panel, Android Auto panel correctly
critical_code_review_comments: SavedDevicesTab.jsx correctly implements all required UI elements with proper data-testid attributes
SettingsTab.jsx correctly adds SavedDevicesTab to NAV_ITEMS between General Settings and Vehicle Parameters
Backend GET /api/dhu/devices endpoint correctly returns all devices from MongoDB
Backend DELETE /api/dhu/device-preferences/{serial} correctly removes device and returns appropriate status
Backend POST /api/dhu/device-preferences correctly performs upsert with all fields
Device cards correctly display name, serial, connection type toggle, display mode toggle, and auto-launch checkbox
Empty state message correctly displays when no devices are saved

seed_data_creation: Two test devices re-seeded after testing: PIXEL7-A1B2C3 (Pixel 7 Pro) and SAMSUNG-X9Y8Z7 (Galaxy S24 Ultra)

mocked_apis.DHU start/stop: Returns error in non-Pi environment since OpenAuto is not installed. This is expected behavior - the API endpoints work correctly, they just can't launch the actual OpenAuto process.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Saved Devices management screen feature fully tested. All backend CRUD endpoints for device preferences working. SavedDevicesTab renders correctly under Settings > Saved Devices with Smartphone icon. Device cards show name, serial, connection type toggle (USB/BT), display mode toggle (Embedded/Fullscreen), auto-launch checkbox, and Remove button.
